page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at the top centre; page number at the top right; no margin notes.

main_text.p: pungenda, animo discentium & memo-riæ imprimendum censuerim. Profun-dus est in Carminibus, mediocris in Sermonibus, supra humani ingenii con-ditionem difertus in epistolis. A. TI-BULLUS amne per amoena rosèta fluente lenitèr decurrens, amotam curis vitam, avaritia procul & invidia degen-dam, commendat. CORNELIUS GALLUS nugas agendo gravis, inter infani amoris anhelas lamentationes, ingravescentis ætatis onus, & immi-nentis mortis minas, facundè deplorat. PROPERTIUS Callimachea Musa sonorus, de vi amoris & vertiginosa miseria, de famæ ex ingenio immortalitate, de mortis nemini evitanda necessitate, de compescenda auri cupiditate, de viribus negotio expendendis, cano-ra gravitate differit. OVIDII NASONIS, quo nemo poëtarum diversissimis materiis cæreum ingenium molliori ductu applicuit, FASTOS.

page.notes: Page is badly worn; the line "Callimachea Musa sonorus" and several words in the middle lines ("rosèta", "degen-dam", "Profun-dus") are uncertain and may be misread. The first line is a fragment of a sentence continued from the previous page. Shows a signature mark "B 6" at the foot, and the bottom line "ob" is a catchword-like fragment at the lower right.
